args.message: Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was quantizing with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, which contradicts its own docstring and the FIN-212 requirement for banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN). This broke the nightly build (`tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`).

## Change
- Switch the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

Verified: e.g. `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66` (ties resolved to even), matching FIN-212.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986`: **passed** (includes `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`).
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212
